description: Frozen scientific criteria for the I3.5.1 governor causal protocol experiment. Uses a 2x2 factorial design: cognitive-state visibility (BLIND/AWARE) x governor availability (OFF/ON). The primary scientific question is whether the governor reduces decision gap beyond what is explained by additional observable information.
claim_boundary: The central scientific question is whether the governor — an advisory decision mechanism — improves executive decisions (DG) beyond what observable information alone provides. This is NOT a question about whether the state contains information (IG) or whether end-to-end regret improves (TR).

definitions.V_L_star: Latent optimal value: V_L^*(s) = optimal value from the full latent state.
definitions.V_O_S: Observable optimal value: V_O^S(B_M(s)) = optimal value from observable information under state condition S. Does NOT depend on governor G.
definitions.V_pi_SG: Controller value: V_pi^{S,G}(s) = realized value from controller under state S and governor G.
definitions.IG_S: Information gap: IG_S(s) = V_L^*(s) - V_O^S(s). Depends on S only, NOT on G.
definitions.DG_SG: Decision gap: DG_{S,G}(s) = V_O^S(s) - V_pi^{S,G}(s). Depends on both S and G.
definitions.oracle_invariance: V_O(BLIND,OFF) == V_O(BLIND,ON) AND V_O(AWARE,OFF) == V_O(AWARE,ON). The governor does not change what information is observable.
definitions.no_clamping: Individual task contributions to IG or DG are NOT clamped.

primary_hypothesis.statement: The governor reduces decision gap under the aware condition: DG_{AWARE,OFF} > DG_{AWARE,ON}.

governor_effect_blind.statement: The governor also reduces DG under blind: ΔDG_gov|blind > 0

state_effect_no_gov.statement: State visibility reduces DG without governor: ΔDG_state|no-gov > 0

interaction.statement: Governor benefit depends on structured state: Δ_interaction > 0

interpretation_matrix.DG11_<<_DG10: Governor helps with structured state (primary claim)
interpretation_matrix.DG01_≈_DG00_AND_DG11_≈_DG10: Governor isn't helping; apparent gain came from state visibility or confounding
interpretation_matrix.DG01_<<_DG00_AND_DG11_<<_DG10: Governor has a general metacontrol effect (not state-specific)
interpretation_matrix.DG01_≈_DG00_AND_DG11_<<_DG10: Governor's value specifically depends on structured cognitive state (synergy)

prohibition_on_substitution: No scientific report may substitute TR for DG. TR = IG + DG, so if ΔIG > 0, then ΔTR > 0 does not imply ΔDG > 0. Reporting ΔTR as evidence of executive exploitation is prohibited.

statistical_plan.paired_design: All four conditions share the same tasks. For each task i, compute paired deltas.
statistical_plan.primary_test: Paired bootstrap on per-task ΔDG_gov|aware differences.

bootstrap.note: Do NOT bootstrap individual transitions as independent observations.

primary_success_criterion.description: The lower bound of the 95% paired bootstrap CI of ΔDG_gov|aware must be strictly positive.

topology_cluster_bootstrap.note: For structural-generalization claims, resample topology clusters, not individual tasks.

multiple_comparisons.note: Applied to the secondary hypothesis family, not to the primary governor-aware comparison.

evaluation_order.note: Each phase must be evaluated and reported before proceeding. No configuration changes between phases.

repetition_policy.nondeterminism_probe: Before scientific evaluation, run a development repeatability probe with identical packets under identical settings.
repetition_policy.if_deterministic: Retain 1 call per task per condition.
repetition_policy.if_nondeterministic: Activate 3-5 repetitions and freeze that count before validation.
repetition_policy.note: Never decide repetition count after held-out performance is visible.

replay_requirements.model_output_reproducibility: Store raw model outputs per step. Replay requires the same prompt, packet, and generation settings.
replay_requirements.evaluation_reproducibility: Given the same parsed action, the trajectory and scoring must be exactly reproducible.
replay_requirements.separation: Model-output nondeterminism is distinguished from deterministic evaluation replay.
replay_requirements.identity_check: TR = IG + DG must hold for every task contribution within tolerance 1e-9.

reporting_requirements.factorial_table: Report the 2x2 DG table: {BLIND/AWARE} x {GOV OFF/ON}.
reporting_requirements.governor_effects: Report ΔDG_gov|aware and ΔDG_gov|blind with CIs.
reporting_requirements.state_effects: Report ΔDG_state|no-gov and ΔDG_state|gov with CIs.
reporting_requirements.success_rates: Report success rates for all four conditions.
reporting_requirements.cost_efficiency: Report model calls and utility per condition.
reporting_requirements.claim_boundary: State explicitly which claim tier is supported.
reporting_requirements.no_tr_substitution: Never report ΔTR as evidence of governor benefit without also reporting ΔDG.

claim_hierarchy.C3: governor benefit generalizes across topology (topology-cluster CI excludes 0)
claim_hierarchy.C5: governor improves utility at equal/lower resource cost

validity_gates.G18: observable oracle invariance (V_O independent of G)
validity_gates.G21: report invariants (count tables tie to N)
validity_gates.void_vs_fail: Any hard-gate failure makes the scientific run VOID, not FAIL. FAIL means a valid experiment whose hypothesis was unsupported.

prohibition: These thresholds, statistical tests, grouping variables, claim boundaries, and validity gates must not be modified after any held-out model evaluation has been run. Any change constitutes a new experiment identity.
